# The Sports House

> > The Sports House provides expert coverage and analysis of NBA, NFL, and MMA sports with insights from seasoned professionals.

The Sports House is a sports news and analysis platform led by Richard Kendrick and Melissa Pendridge, offering comprehensive coverage of major professional sports leagues. The site combines expert commentary with accessible sports journalism for fans seeking in-depth coverage and analysis.

## Key Topics

- NBA
- NFL
- MMA
- Richard Kendrick
- Melissa Pendridge
- Sports Analysis
- Expert Commentary
- Sports Coverage
- Team Bios
- Customer Support
- Sports Journalism
